answer_1.quote: we investigate we compare human and LLM politeness strategies in English-language scenarios... We collect and analyze a new dataset of openended responses from both humans and LLMs to identical social scenarios
answer_1.outputs: Generated feedback responses in social scenarios

answer_2.quote: We report Spearman correlation and mean squared error (MSE) between LLM and human responses as an overall measure of fit

answer_3.quote: We used LLMs (GPT-4.1 and Claude-3.7-Sonnet) as annotators... to identify and annotate the specific word(s) or phrase(s) in Person B's response that function as politeness markers

answer_4.quote: we conducted a two-alternative forced-choice evaluation with 156 human evaluators... recruited from Prolific
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators selected between response pairs based on goal congruence, rating congruence, and source (human vs LLM)
